summary: Same early II catalog row that yields affiliate clubId also embeds teamId+dup; mid-file team body (often under 64 ff 24) owns the subunit job-list. Do not chase 64 ff 00 + clubId — that object is ~0.7MB after the list and is not the join key.

discovery.input: managed parent short name only (e.g. Schalke 04)
steps: Discover II clubId via ii-clubid-discovery-v1 (lp32 + f'{S} II' → after_name+23)
On the same short-name catalog hit, search backward ≤256 bytes for pre-name motif: 00 91 00 00 00 | ff×4 | 91 00 00 00 | 91 00 00 00
Immediately before that motif read: <teamId:u32le> <dup:u32le> <dup:u32le> (the two dups must be equal and >1000)
Optional: body may be preceded by 64 ff 24 (common) — NOT required (Kaiserslautern / Karlsruhe omit it)
From the dup pair, within +96 bytes, parse subunit header: ff×4 | 00 | ff×4 | <count:u16∈[3,50]> | <jobs:u32×n>
Require a majority of jobs in 50000..2000000

teamBodyLayout.optionalPrefix: 64 ff 24 immediately before teamId when present

discovery.subunitHeader: ff×4 | u32 | u32 | ff×4 | 00 | ff×4 | count:u16 | jobs:u32×n  (parser anchors on the trailing ff×4|00|ff×4 before count)

falsePositives.64ff00+clubId: Club-table object (e.g. Schalke II @57753619) — spatial gap ~+0.73MB from list; no reliable pointer to subunit jobs
falsePositives.tid-only 64ff24 scan: Misses packed rows without 64 ff 24 prefix (K'lautern, Karlsruhe on this probe)
falsePositives.count floor 12: Too strict — Werder Bremen II list n=5 on this probe; use [3,50] + jobish majority
falsePositives.post-dup require 0a00: Too strict — only first byte is stably 0a

Schalke 04.note: verification outputs only — do not hardcode as discovery inputs

crossClubProbe.note: 8/8 parent shorts resolve clubId+teamId+job-list on fmt-probe-wmr70v8a.bin

u19.note: Separate recipe: mid-file name→list colocation (~150 bytes), not II clubId/team-body join.

extractWiringNextStep: In squad discovery: after resolving managed parent short, call II catalog clubId+teamId join (this fixture) to obtain job UIDs
Do not overload FT 7f02 / manager teamId 193616 path for II
Feed discovered jobs into existing job→person→attributes/CA·PA pipeline
Re-calibrate anchor players per save (job IDs move with transfers); treat Ermin 237871 as probe-only verification
